stories.title: Federal prosecutors identify 18 alleged rigged pitches for Clase trial
stories.summary: Prosecutors identified 18 pitches, including one from a 2024 playoff game, that will be the focus of their case against Guardians closer Emmanuel Clase that is set for trial in November, according to court documents.

stories.title: NFL changes rules governing videoboards after ex-coach's viral post
stories.summary: The NFL has modified what can be shown on videoboards during field goal and extra point attempts, an alteration coming in the wake of a viral social media post from a former analytics coach.

stories.title: Rams' Nacua again misses practice, questionable for MNF
stories.summary: Rams receiver Puka Nacua will not practice for the second day in a row and will be listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the Giants.

stories.title: Beltran, inducted into team HOF, says no current interest in Mets job
stories.summary: Carlos Beltran wouldn't rule out interviewing to become manager of the Mets, a job he left before he ran a single game in 2020, but he didn't sound all that interested.

stories.title: Orioles activate Bautista after 14-month absence; Mancini retires
stories.summary: The Orioles activated reliever Félix Bautista after a 14-month absence following shoulder surgery. In addition, Trey Mancini signed a one-day deal and has retired.
